title: 40 days after surgery, he won the Olympics again (Part 2)
description:
Part 2 of the Abebe Bikila story. Tokyo 1964: forty days after an appendectomy, Bikila won the Olympic marathon by over four minutes - another world record, and the first back-to-back marathon champion in history. In 1969 a car crash left him unable to walk. He competed in archery and table tennis at the 1970 Stoke Mandeville Games, and won a cross-country sled race in Norway in 1971. He died at 41; 65,000 people attended his funeral. Ethiopia's national stadium carries his name.
Part 1 - the barefoot world record in Rome - is on the channel.
